answer: Peer judgment is the scarce resource: rewards flow only when established peers read an answer and attest it worthy — presence alone pays nothing. A sybil farm hits a quality gate: every puppet must write essays good enough that independent graders anchor their names to them. Graders pulse through the queue each epoch; junk never accumulates — unattested answers expire worthless, like nectar nobody gathered. Farming profit means farming competence: each fake identity needs real writing and real reading, every epoch. Attacker cost: a hundred puppets must each out-write the peers they rob.
